name: compare_artifacts
description: Compare complete artifact inventories, including FIT and legacy uImage firmware components, by logical occurrence path, content identity, metadata, and graph relations. The root path . describes the outer container separately from its components. Name each side once without resending Evidence: {kind: "retained-evidence", evidence_id} selects an inspect_artifact result, its nested inventory, or its inspect_analysis_view summary retained in this session; {kind: "evidence-file", path, evidence_id?} reads one record from a local Evidence file or bundle at an absolute path. Complete inline Evidence is also accepted. Summary facts are not treated as a complete inventory; comparison resolves the exact complete parent from the same source bundle or the retained session. Every delta cites both complete inputs, and gaps yield truncated or unknown, never equivalence. Returns every change inline.
